observations: Photo 0 shows a light-colored 2-seater couch/sofa with rounded arms and backrest.
Upholstery appears like leather or leatherette (smooth surface, visible seams).
Photo 0 shows some light scuffing/marks on the seat area (hard to confirm depth).
Photo 1 shows the corner/arm and seat cushion; there are faint stains/marks on the seat surface.
No visible brand label, model tag, or manufacturer markings in either photo.

claims.claim: Very neat 2 seater couch for sale
claims.evidence: Photos show a generally clean-looking sofa, but there are visible light marks/stains on the seat surface; 'very neat' is subjective and not fully verifiable from these angles.

risks.risk: Hidden tears, cracks, or peeling in the upholstery (leather/leatherette) not visible from these two angles.
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of the arm edges, bottom seam/underside, and any creases, plus a photo of the backrest corners.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not fully confirmed (worst case: upholstery may need cleaning/repair).

risks.risk: Cushion sagging or weak springs/frame (comfort/structure) not shown in static photos.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of someone pressing down on the seat and back (showing bounce-back) and a photo of the underside if possible.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as average/possibly worn (worst case: reduced comfort).

risks.risk: Stains/odor (e.g., from spills or pets) not detectable from photos.
risks.proof: Ask the seller to confirm whether it has any stains/odor and request a photo after wiping/cleaning the seat area; ideally a short smell/cleaning confirmation video.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as may have stains/needs cleaning.

risks.risk: Color mismatch due to lighting; actual condition may be worse than it appears.
risks.proof: Ask for photos taken in daylight near a window (same angles) to compare true color and marks.
risks.if_unproven: Priced conservatively based on visible marks.

proof_requests: Close-up photos of upholstery seams, arm edges, and any creases (front + sides).
A short video showing seat bounce-back (press test) and backrest stability.
Photo of the underside/bottom frame area (for damage or missing parts).
Daylight photos to confirm the extent of stains/scuffs.
response.reason: It looks like a 2-seater leather/leatherette sofa, but the photos don’t clearly confirm upholstery integrity, cushion condition, or whether the visible seat marks are stains or damage. Missing proof prevents confident worst-case pricing.
